title: TRINETRA-HARD row
description: One JSONL row per observation in datasets/trinetra-hard/index.jsonl. Per SPEC_TRINETRA_HARD.md §4.

slice_reason.description: why this slice was chosen when conditions overlap

eligible.description: true only if the plate is actually readable in this rendering/frame

label_source.description: synthetic_truth: text is known because it was the generator's own input, not guessed by OCR or a human. unverified_real: real footage, true plate string is unknown -- always eligible:false, plate_text:null, used only for stability diagnostics, never scored for accuracy. Only human and synthetic_truth are scoreable.

degradation_params.description: synthetic_truth rows only: the per-frame degradation actually applied (seed, blur kernel, gamma, warp, etc.)

plate_bbox_source.description: annotated = real plate-region ground truth; estimated_from_vehicle_bbox = no plate annotation exists, bbox is a heuristic sub-region of a real vehicle box (indian_road); whole_image = pre-cropped source; rendered = synthetic frame, bbox is exact by construction

track_type.description: approach: width varies within the track (vehicle crossing frame). fixed_distance: width constant within the track, degradation varies per frame -- the honest per-bucket fusion question. real_footage: indian_road, diagnostic only.
